_about: The Mages City evidence registry. One entry per kind of evidence a mage can bring. To add a kind (for example a shared autoresearch scroll): add an entry here and a verifier module under /evidence/ that registers CityEvidence.verifiers[<verifier>]. status: live | soon | hidden.

types.label: City Key
types.where: Your City Key from agentprivacy.ai, carrying the trinkets and artefacts you gathered on Spellweb and the Star.
types.dropText: Drop your City Key (.json), or the key with its VTA record

types.label: Drake Orb
types.where: The stone you laid at the threshold of Drake Island: export your stone proof from the Star at agentprivacy.ai. It carries every quest you walked, sealed into one root.
types.dropText: Drop your Drake Orb: the stone proof from Drake Island (.json)

types.label: Hitchhiker’s star
types.where: Your entry in the Hitchhiker’s Guide to Trust evidence ledger.
types.dropText: Drop the star ledger JSON from the guide’s evidence page, or paste the note
